description: Source code for SparkConnectAddArtifactsHandler class, which manages artifact uploads via gRPC stream, including handling multi-chunk artifacts, CRC validation, and artifact management within Spark Connect service.

classes.name: SparkConnectAddArtifactsHandler
classes.description: Handles streaming artifact upload requests, manages temporary storage, CRC validation, and final artifact registration.

classes.name: StagedArtifact
classes.description: Represents a temporary stored artifact, supports writing data, CRC validation, and generating artifact summaries.

classes.name: StagedChunkedArtifact
classes.description: Extends StagedArtifact to handle multi-chunk artifacts, managing chunk count, total bytes, and CRC validation across chunks.

methods.name: onNext
methods.description: Processes incoming AddArtifactsRequest, handling beginning, chunked, or batch artifact uploads.

methods.name: onError
methods.description: Handles errors during streaming, cleans up temporary artifacts.

methods.name: addStagedArtifactToArtifactManager
methods.description: Adds a staged artifact to the artifact manager for persistence.

methods.name: flushStagedArtifacts
methods.description: Processes all staged artifacts, uploads them if CRC checks pass, and returns summaries.

methods.name: cleanUpStagedArtifacts
methods.description: Deletes temporary staging directory and artifacts.

methods.name: writeArtifactToFile (SingleChunkArtifact)
methods.description: Creates a staged artifact from a single chunk.

methods.name: writeArtifactToFile (BeginChunkedArtifact)
methods.description: Creates a staged chunked artifact and writes the initial chunk.

methods.name: updateCrc
methods.description: Updates CRC validation status for the artifact.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes a data chunk to the artifact, updating CRC.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Finalizes the artifact, computes final CRC, and builds summary.
